description: For \(\kappa=\aleph_\omega\), the set \(A=\{\aleph_n:n<\omega\}\) is countably infinite, satisfies \(\bigcup A=\kappa\) and \(A\subseteq H_\kappa\), and has \(\kappa\subseteq\operatorname{TC}(\{A\})\). Consequently \(A\notin H_\kappa\).
